page0.text:
I'm the only one who can move easily.
Both Archer and Tohsaka have been disabled by Rider's Mystic Eyes.
So, if we remove the common cause...!

page1.text:
I run at Rider.
Even if I can't take her down, I can at least break her gaze on Archer for a second!
"...!? Have you lost your mind!? Don't look directly at Rider!"
I ignore Archer's voice and charge at Rider.
If those Mystic Eyes petrify people, then I can just close my eyes.
The hallway is narrow.
I know how far I am from Rider.
Whether Rider reacts to me or I manage to pull off my suicide charge, it might create an opening for Archer...!
But, my legs are frozen.
They've actually turned to stone.

page2.text:
"Wha..."
Not just my legs.
The petrification reaches my waist, hardening my torso, freezing my arms, and sealing my eyelids shut forever.
"Ev...?"

page3.text:
"How foolish.
Did you think closing your eyes would be enough to block my Mystic Eyes? Everything I see is cursed, whether physical or spiritual."

page4.text:
"..."
My throat and mouth won't move.
...I can't even tell what's happening around me.
I'm a stone statue that has no way of knowing
whether Tohsaka's screaming,
or Archer's crumbling to pieces.
